info.title: API-DocTest-List Airline Flights Baggages-v5-spec
info.description: The Airline Baggage Information API provides users with access to detailed information regarding baggage associated with airline flights. This API supports inquiries into baggage status, weight limits, and policies, allowing consumers such as travel agencies and airline personnel to efficiently manage passenger baggage inquiries. It serves as a crucial resource for improving customer service and streamlining baggage handling processes. Use this API to ensure your systems are updated with the latest baggage information for various flights.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed baggage information associated with flights, including baggage limits, fees, and other relevant details to ensure a smooth travel experience.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving baggage information related to flights. This may include specific details regarding the baggage items, their current status, and any associated flight identification necessary for processing the request.

ListAirlineFlightsBaggagesRequest.description: A request body schema representing the baggage information for flight operations.
